title: OKX Referral Code Benefits: What You Actually Get

lines.show: Using an OKX referral code can make you eligible for the new user welcome program, and it links you to the person who invited you.
What it does not do is change your fees or give you a special kind of account.
Let's answer the questions people ask most.
Question one: do you get rewards for using a code?
OKX runs welcome programs for new users, and a referral can be part of that.
The exact rewards, tasks and deadlines are listed in the app's rewards page, and they change over time.
Welcome rewards usually come with tasks, like finishing verification.
Some also have deadlines, so read each step before you start.
Here's how to see what applies to you.
Log in to the OKX app.
Open the main menu or the home screen shortcuts.
Tap the rewards or rewards center section. The name can vary by app version.
Then read each task, its deadline, and the terms at the bottom.

scenes.title: Does it lower my fees?
scenes.text: Fees follow the official fee page.

lines.show: Question two: does a referral code lower your trading fees?
Don't assume it does. Fees follow OKX's official fee page and your account tier.
If a fee offer exists for you, the app will show it.
With or without a code, you get the same app and the same rules.
Verification, security settings and withdrawal checks work the same way for everyone.
So a code is a starting point, not a shortcut around the normal checks.

scenes.title: Is a code risky?
scenes.text: A typed code is low risk.

lines.show: Question three: is it risky to use someone's code?
Typing a code into the official app is low risk. It only creates the referral link.
The risk comes from fake links and people asking for your login, not from the code itself.

scenes.title: Never trade your login
scenes.text: No code is worth your password.

lines.show: So keep one rule: never share your password or verification codes with anyone offering a code.
Also keep in mind that offers can depend on where you live.
If you don't see a program someone mentioned online, it may simply not apply in your country.
Before you sign up, check three things.
That OKX serves your country.
That you've read the current rewards terms.
And that you downloaded the official app.
Those three minutes can save you a lot of trouble later.
